title: Sum an array with a for loop
hints: Put a `for` loop between `let total = ref 0 in` and `!total`, and end the loop with `done;`.
The indexes of an array of length n are 0 to n - 1. So the loop is `for i = 0 to Array.length a - 1 do ... done`.

answer.explain: The reference loops `for i = 0 to Array.length a - 1` and does `total := !total + a.(i)`, then returns `!total`. Writing `to Array.length a` without the `- 1` reads one slot past the end and raises `Invalid_argument "index out of bounds"`. For an empty array the loop runs zero times and the sum stays 0.
